definitions.explanation: A seat that is available on a first-come, first-served basis without prior reservation.

examples.japanese: {自由席|じゆうせき}は{早|はや}い{者|もの}{勝|が}ちだ。
{自由席|じゆうせき}なら{予約|よやく}なしで{乗|の}れる。
examples.english: With unreserved seats, you can ride without a reservation.

examples.japanese: {自由席|じゆうせき}{車両|しゃりょう}は{混|こ}んでいた。
examples.english: The unreserved seat car was crowded.

examples.japanese: {自由席|じゆうせき}の{方|ほう}が{指定席|していせき}より{安|やす}い。
examples.english: Unreserved seats are cheaper than reserved seats.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}{早|はや}い{電車|でんしゃ}なら{自由席|じゆうせき}でも{座|すわ}れると{思|おも}う。
examples.english: If you take an early morning train, I think you can get a seat even in the unreserved cars.

notes:
FORMATION:
{自由|じゆう} (free/unrestricted) + {席|せき} (seat)

CONTRAST:
・{自由席|じゆうせき} - unreserved seat (cheaper, no guarantee of seat)
・{指定席|していせき} - reserved seat (guaranteed seat for extra fee)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{自由席|じゆうせき}に{座|すわ}る - to sit in an unreserved seat
・{自由席|じゆうせき}{車両|しゃりょう} - unreserved seat car
・{自由席|じゆうせき}{券|けん} - unreserved seat ticket

TRAIN CONTEXT:
On the Shinkansen, unreserved cars ({自由席|じゆうせき}{車両|しゃりょう}) are typically at the ends of the train. During busy times, passengers may have to stand.

COST:
{自由席|じゆうせき} is cheaper than {指定席|していせき} because no {指定席|していせき}{料金|りょうきん} (reserved seat fee) is charged.
